reference_sql:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
with_total AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, spend,
         SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id) AS channel_spend
  FROM campaign_spend
)
SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, spend, channel_spend
FROM with_total
WHERE spend > 0.1 * channel_spend
alternatives:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
channel_spend AS (  -- one row per channel with spend
  SELECT channel_id, SUM(spend) AS total_spend
  FROM campaign_spend
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT cs.campaign_id, cs.channel_id, cs.spend, ch.total_spend AS channel_spend
FROM campaign_spend cs
JOIN channel_spend ch ON ch.channel_id = cs.channel_id
WHERE cs.spend > 0.1 * ch.total_spend

SELECT t.campaign_id, t.channel_id, t.spend, t.channel_spend
FROM (
  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend,
         SUM(SUM(a.spend)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel_id) AS channel_spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
) AS t
WHERE t.spend > 0.1 * t.channel_spend
